messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: high 5xx error rate detected for route /v1/embeddings in region us-west1. Current rate: 18% 5xx over 5m window. Trigger: error_rate_threshold.

pagerduty: Incident #INC-1724 created and paged -> escalation policy: SRE Rotation.

oncall-sre: acked the page. I'm on it.

alice: looking at logs now — preliminary trace shows spikes in backend kv-proxy errors: 
```
2024-11-03T07:12:33Z ERROR kv-proxy: upstream 502: context canceled id=3f9b
2024-11-03T07:12:34Z WARN  inference-gateway: retry 3 for req=abcd1234 latency=412ms
```

oncall-sre: thanks. Can you confirm if this is only embeddings or across generation endpoints?

alice: cursory check: embeddings heavy, generation endpoints stable. Sample query ids show kv-proxy 502s around request fanout.

bob: I'm checking pool metrics for the us-west1 dedicated cluster. Kernel queue depth spiked ~07:11–07:14. Might be a KV cache eviction cascade. Increasing pool size by +2 nodes now (manual scale).

oncall-sre: temporarily reducing max_concurrency for embeddings route to 10 to limit downstream pressure. Pushing config: `redwoodctl route update --route embeddings --max-concurrency 10`.

emily: CS: Notifying Workspace CSMs and publishing a brief note to status channel (no public status page update yet). Tagging customers with high-SLA traffic.

ops-mgr: good. If scaling doesn't drop 5xx within 3 minutes, prepare for traffic reroute to eu-fallback. Keep me posted every 2m.

oncall-sre: scale applied (bob). Reducing concurrency in prod pushed. Will monitor.

incident-bot: Autoscaler event: 2 nodes added to us-west1-dedicated (started). Expected warmup ~90s.

alice: seeing 5xx rate drop from 18% -> 7% in last 90s. Errors now mostly 502 from kv-proxy.

oncall-sre: continuing monitor. If 5xx < 2% for 10m, we'll close. If not, we'll fail traffic to eu-fallback and run deeper heap/kvcache analysis.

emily: CS update sent to affected accounts with recommended temporary retry guidance and ETA for mitigation.

customer-ops: received the note, customers asking for ETA. They want to know if data retention or corruption risk exists.

oncall-sre: no indication of data loss — errors are upstream connection failures. We'll include that in the CS update.

bob: warm nodes healthy; kernel queue normalized. I'm scheduling a postmortem triage in #incidents-postmortems after we resolve.

oncall-sre: 5xx now at 1.2% over 5m. Continuing to observe for 10m.

ops-mgr: thanks team. If anything spikes again, escalate to SEV2.

incident-bot: Alert resolved: 5xx rate returned below threshold. Incident auto-closed after sustained recovery.

emily: CS: follow-up note queued explaining mitigation steps and next steps for affected customers.

oncall-sre: closing out here; will add logs + timeline to postmortem ticket. Great work. :thumbsup:
